name: leadpack-xc
description: LeadPack XC - Cross Country Analytics Platform

scripts.build: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd web && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
